notes: Truth fixes vs the concept: the real alarm is stamped 16:16, so 'Relatório da noite… Bom dia.' became 'Relatório da hunt:' and the ending became 'Relatório direto no zap.' (no night/morning implied). The voice note is an obvious skit (KizuBot does not send audio); the proof is the real text alarm alarme-12335-itens--alarm (tagged 'print real de cliente', shown below its 660 px soft source width), with the hero counter 0→12.335 ('itens dropados' = 'Total dropped items') and a line-by-line highlight over the print; 'Que chique kk' is the customer's own reply in the same crop. End-card question wrapped to 3 lines to stay inside x≤880. Rubric: hook 8, re-hooks 9, clarity 8, craft 8, truth 9, sound 9, brand 9, CTA 8, loop 8, distinct 9 = 8.5.
